button.name: Import From External Format
button.button_desc: Import models into WhereScape 3D from the following formats: - ERwin xsd (*.xsd) - PowerDesigner conceptual, logical and physical models (*.cdm, *.ldm, *.pdm) - Common warehouse metamodel (*.xmi) - 3D xml (*.xml, *.ws3d) ER/Studio models can be exported as native WhereScape 3D models files from Team Server.

button.name: Document Model
button.button_desc: Generate model and source system documentation, data validation documentation or documentation comparing source systems.

button.name: Compare Models
button.button_desc: Compare the structure, business rules or profiling metrics for multiple models.

button.name: Generate DDL
button.button_desc: Generate DDL for all entities in a model, with the option to filter by target location.

button.name: Create Star Schema
button.button_desc: The Creating a Star Schema wizard enables you to create a star schema from source data.

button.name: Advanced Copy
button.button_desc: Copy a model with the ability to configure the following settings: - Set the copied versions to use the original source mappings. - Import hidden objects. - Apply model conversions.

button.name: Merge Into Other Model
button.button_desc: It can often be useful to merge changes to a model into another model particularly when working in a repository or on a design imported from another modeling tool.
